One addition:

- You can now remove tasks from the Tasks page. Swipe a task card to the left, long-press it, or tap the ⋮ on the card and choose Remove task; Friday asks before it removes anything. The ⋮ menu next to Refresh at the top has Remove all tasks. A removed task stops checking right away, its alert is cleared, and it does not come back after closing Friday or restarting the phone. When no task is left, the background checker and its "Friday background checks" notification stop too.

Built on v1.0.164, with all of its changes kept (floating bar restore, in-app updates, trading from Friday). Trading is unchanged. Signed with the same key, so it installs over v1.0.164, v1.0.163, v1.0.162 or v1.0.161 with no uninstall. Checked by CI tests, not yet on a phone.
